prompt: Create only the REAR view of this DOWN gray stone stair flight, from the back side opposite the tread approach. The FIRST reference is an independently approved same-family stair REAR geometry guide: reproduce its rear-facing broad stone support wall between two tall parapet/sidewall stacks, with no exposed stair treads. Use the SECOND reference source-plus-six image for the target material and exact orientation only: retain its dark gray cobbles, mossy olive stains, and the correct DOWN high/low end. Do not reuse the guide brown stones. This is not a top view and not a three-quarter view: straight-on rear elevation, opaque masonry backing panel with matching side caps. No upper tread steps, no descending view into the flight, no front-facing staircase. Transparent background, complete centered silhouette, inferred orthographic art.

reference_inputs.role: approved rear support geometry guide only
canonical target source and view identity/material; target UP/DOWN direction

geometry_constraints: rear face is broad opaque wall between two side parapets
rejection_reason: Even with approved same-family rear geometry guide, output retained exposed stair treads; do not install.
